verdicts.reason: Heading and para 1 challenge 'Dr. Marcus Helvétius' as presiding arbitrator under Art. 14(1).
Para 53 cites 'Orange List item 3.3.7' plus the same-counsel three-year appointment category.
Paras 4, 26(a), 75-77 weigh Northvale, repeat appointments, keynote, AutoBuild cumulatively.
Orange and Green Lists discussed; Red List never mentioned anywhere in the submission.
Para 46 places Northvale advisory service within Orange List professional-association and financial-interest categories.
Para 66: keynote/counsel interaction 'engages the Orange List categories concerned with professional relationships'.
Para 26 objective 'reasonable and informed third party'; prayer (2) ties justifiable doubts to Art. 14(1).
Paras 5 and 80: no actual bias alleged; 'The standard is one of appearance, deliberately so'.
Section IX Ground 4 advances non-disclosure as a distinct ground undermining confidence (paras 69, 73).
Para 18: 'Article 11(3) makes that duty a continuing one throughout the arbitration'; also paras 73, 84.
Para 27 names 'IBA Guidelines on Conflicts of Interest in International Arbitration (2014, as revised 2024)'.
